findings.summary: Bulk channel policy changes lack active policy revision fencing, allowing stale admin decisions to overwrite newer policy epochs.
findings.details: The task requires stale-generation race protection for the multi-channel policy control plane. The implementation fences source channel connection/access generation, but the mutation contract has no per-channel expected routing policy epoch or delivery generation. buildBulkPolicyPlan compares against the active policy at mutation time and creates a new epoch whenever the requested policy differs, so a stale UI submit made before another admin changed the same channel can still succeed as long as the channel access generation is unchanged. That silently supersedes the newer policy and violates the required stale-generation/revision fencing for concurrent policy updates.
